versions.description_html:
Learn how to fix bad machine data, missing values, timestamps, and data quality issues before they reach Power BI dashboards in manufacturing.

Dashboards are only as good as the machine data feeding them. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we cover common data quality problems: missing values, naming, timestamps and units, and how to fix them before they reach Power BI.
You will learn how to build data quality checks into the pipeline.
Who it is for: Data engineers, BI developers and manufacturing analysts.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Power BI Semantic Models - Simply Explained
  • How Machine Data Reaches Microsoft Fabric - From OPC UA to Real-Time Analytics
  • More Data Governance episodes on M365.FM
